cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
# burst-only differential round with skew toward burst mode
import json, random, subprocess, sys
SUB='/workspace/submission/scheduler.py'; REF='/workspace/dev/ref.py'
bad=0
for i in range(150):
    rng = random.Random(90000+i)
    Q = rng.randint(1,16); L = rng.randint(1,8)
    U = rng.choice([1,2,6,50,1000])
    pts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1,U), rng.randint(1, min(31, U-1)))) if U>1 else []
    borders=[0]+pts+[U]
    n = rng.randint(0,120)
    # heavy tie / skew
    if rng.random()<0.5:
        pool = rng.sample(range(U), min(3, U))
        ranks=[rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(n)]
    else:
        ranks=[rng.randrange(U) for _ in range(n)]
    pkts=[{'id':'x%d'%j,'lane':rng.randrange(L),'rank':ranks[j]} for j in range(n)]
    req={'mode':'burst','banks':Q,'lanes':L,'limit':U,'borders':borders,
         'start_bank':rng.randrange(Q),'packets':pkts}
    d=json.dumps(req).encode()
    a=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',SUB],input=d,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    b=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',REF],input=d,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    ja, jb = json.loads(a.stdout), json.loads(b.stdout)
    if ja != jb:
        print('MISMATCH', 90000+i); print(json.dumps(req)); bad+=1; break
    for rs in ja['ranges']:
        if rs['observed'] > rs['bound']:
            print('BOUND VIOLATION', 90000+i, rs); bad+=1; break
    # departures must be ordered by tick and cover all packets exactly once
    ds = ja['departures']
    assert [x['t'] for x in ds] == sorted(x['t'] for x in ds)
    assert sorted(x['id'] for x in ds) == sorted(p['id'] for p in pkts)
print('burst-only round failures =', bad)
EOF
